title: Ongoing Management
meta: Set up regular care for your Shopify store: a task calendar, a first month of work and a clear report. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: Regular care works best when it starts with a plan. We review your store, agree a monthly task list with you, and then do the first round of tasks inside the sprint: product updates, app and theme checks, small fixes, orders and a report. You get a calendar of what happens each week and a written summary at the end. The monthly plan that follows is quoted separately.

pkgs.blurb: A care plan for your store and the first tasks done.
A first full month of care, with updates along the way.
A full care month plus a growth plan for the quarter.

faq: Small repeatable jobs like adding a product, editing a banner, updating a page, changing a store setting or applying an app update. Larger builds are quoted separately so the sprint stays on time.
No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a set number of tasks. If it works for you, we quote a monthly plan afterward, based on what your store actually needed during the sprint.
How do I send you tasks?
Through the order form and then email or the shared task list we set up on day one. Each task gets a status, so you always see what is done, what is in progress and what is waiting for you.
You do. Everything is done in your own Shopify account under your own staff accounts, so you can see all changes in the activity log and remove our access whenever you like.
